name: Ramp
bestFor: AI-automated corporate card, spend, and accounts-payable management with a genuinely free core plan
description: A finance operations platform (corporate cards, expense management, AP/invoice OCR) with Ramp Intelligence: a natural-language finance assistant, AI policy generation, and agentic approval of routine transactions.

freeTier.limits: Free plan: unlimited corporate cards, expense management, AP with invoice OCR, basic accounting automation

paidTier.notes: Ramp Plus is $15/user/month, adding advanced approval workflows, custom policies, and procurement. Ramp Enterprise is custom-priced with dedicated support and enterprise SSO.

name: Mosaic
bestFor: AI-assisted FP&A: automated reporting, forecasting, and metrics pulled straight from source systems
description: A strategic finance / FP&A platform that connects to ERP, CRM, and HRIS systems to automate reporting and build driver-based financial models and forecasts, with AI-assisted analysis.

freeTier.limits: No free tier; demo-and-quote sales process

paidTier.notes: Mosaic does not publish pricing on its website. Plans are described as Analytics, Foundation, and Growth deployment tiers, scoped by team size and modules, all requiring a custom quote.

name: Vic.ai
bestFor: Autonomous, high-volume invoice processing for finance teams that want AP off their plate
description: An AI-first accounts payable platform that autonomously processes, codes, and approves invoices at high confidence thresholds, reducing manual AP data entry.

freeTier.limits: No free tier or self-serve trial; enterprise-only annual contracts

paidTier.notes: No public price list; priced by user count, monthly invoice volume, and module mix (Autopilot, VicAnalytics, VicCard, VicPay). Reported deal sizes run from roughly $25,000 to several hundred thousand dollars per year.
